source.author: ov
source.text: Pronaque cum spectent animalia cetera terram, os homini sublime dedit, caelumque videre iussit et erectos ad sidera tollere vultus.
source.text_original: Pronaque cum spectent animalia cetera terram, / os homini sublime dedit, caelumque videre / iussit et erectos ad sidera tollere vultus.
source.text_english: And while all other animals look down toward the earth, he gave man an uplifted face and commanded him to gaze at the heavens and to raise his countenance erect toward the stars.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: quod optime ingeniosus poeta signauit: pronaque cum spectent animalia cetera terram, os homini sublime dedit caelumque uidere iussit et erectos ad sidera tollere uultus.
reuse.text_original: quod optime ingeniosus poeta signauit: pronaque cum spectent animalia cetera terram, os homini sublime dedit caelumque uidere iussit et erectos ad sidera tollere uultus.
reuse.text_english: which the gifted poet marked most excellently: and while the other animals gaze earthward, he gave man a face raised aloft and ordered him to look at heaven and lift his countenance upright to the stars.
